clOrderId.description: Client-assigned order id echoed from placement.

originalOrderSize.description: Original order size in number of contracts at placement.

currentOrderSize.description: Current remaining order size in number of contracts after fills and amendments.

totalFilledSize.description: Cumulative filled size in number of contracts.

remainingSize.description: Remaining unfilled size in number of contracts.

averageFillPrice.description: Average fill price across executions so far.

timestamp.description: Server timestamp of the last state change, in milliseconds since epoch.

reduceOnly.description: True if the order can only reduce an existing position.

positionMode.description: Position mode this order applies to (one-way or hedge).

positionDirection.description: Position direction the order affects: LONG or SHORT.

positionId.description: Identifier of the position the order is bound to.

closeOrder.description: True if the order is a close-position order.

pegPriceMin.description: Lower bound of the peg order price band.

pegPriceMax.description: Upper bound of the peg order price band.

pegPriceDeviation.description: Offset applied to the pegged reference price.

triggerOrder.description: True if this order is a conditional trigger order that has not yet fired.

triggered.description: True once the trigger condition has fired.

triggerOriginalPrice.description: Original submitted trigger price prior to any amendment.

triggerOrderType.description: Order type code the trigger will submit once fired.

triggerTrailingStopDeviation.description: Trailing distance for the trigger's trailing-stop behavior.

triggerStopPrice.description: Stop price used by the triggered order once activated.

triggerUseLastPrice.description: True if last-traded-price is used as the trigger reference, otherwise mark price is used.

trailValue.description: Trailing distance the stop maintains from the best reached reference price.

trailValueType.description: How trailValue is interpreted (absolute price offset or percentage).

activationPrice.description: Price at which trailing or scheduled logic activates.

activationPriceType.description: Reference price type used to evaluate the activation price.

cancelDuration.description: Cancel duration in milliseconds derived from time-in-force. Zero for GTC.

timeInForce.description: Time-in-force policy applied to the order (e.g. GTC, IOC, FOK).

stealth.description: Portion of the order size displayed on the book; the remainder is hidden.

contractSize.description: Contract size (units of underlying per contract) for this symbol.

wrapperOrder.description: True if the order is a wrapper that spawns child orders (e.g. activation wrappers).

ocoPeerOrderId.description: Order id of the peer OCO leg, if this order is part of an OCO pair.

originalOrderValue.description: Notional value at placement, computed from original size, contract size and reference price.

currentOrderValue.description: Current notional value, computed from remaining size, contract size and current working price.

orderId.description: Server-assigned order id of the attached trigger order.

side.description: Order side of the trigger leg: BUY or SELL.

triggerPrice.description: Price at which this trigger fires.

triggerUseLastPrice.description: True if last-traded-price is used as the trigger reference, otherwise mark price is used.
